title: Useful content and a clear next step

sections.skill: Create useful content with a single next step

questions.domain: Foundation 11: Marketing, sales and social media
questions.prompt: What makes content useful?

choices.text: It uses as many complicated words as possible
It talks only about how great the owner is
It helps the reader before asking for anything
It repeats "buy now" as many times as possible

questions.correct_answer: It helps the reader before asking for anything
questions.intro: Useful marketing content helps the reader before asking for anything: a short tip, an answer to a common question, a before-and-after photo of real work, or a simple how-to. Each piece should end with one clear NEXT STEP, such as "Book a call" or "See this week's menu." Write for one type of reader, use plain words, and be specific. "5 ways to keep your houseplants alive in winter" is more useful than "We love plants!"

questions.domain: Foundation 11: Marketing, sales and social media
questions.prompt: Why do people think of the helpful neighbor first?
questions.intro: Think of a neighbor who knows a lot about gardening. She shares tips freely, and when you need a garden designed, you think of her first. Useful content works the same way: you help people with small, specific tips, and they remember you. At the end, you mention one simple way to work with you, not ten.
